description: Raids - Obtain any raids armour piece or offhand
Zulrah - Obtain 3 uniques
DT2 - Obtain 1 SRA or Virtus piece
The Hueycoatl - Obtain tome of earth or dragon hunter wand
Nex - Obtain any unique (excl. pet, shards)
The Corrupted Gauntlet - Obtain 2 armour seeds or 1 enhanced weapon seed
GWD - Obtain 1 hilt
Wilderness - Obtain any wilderness ring
Tombs of Amascut - Obtain a Lightbearer or Osmumten's Fang
Moons of Peril - Complete one Moons set
Slayer - Obtain 3 slayer boss uniques (excl. pets, teleports, jars)
Guardians of the Rift - Obtain any dye or lantern
Doom of Mokhaiotl - Obtain any unique (excl. demon tears, teleport, pet)
The Royal Titans - Complete 2 twinflame staffs
Yama - Obtain any unique without using contracts (excl. teleport, shards, contracts, pet)
DKs - Obtain all 4 DKs rings (Warrior, Berserker, Archer, and Seers)
Theatre of Blood - Obtain an avernic defender hilt, rapier, or sanguinesti staff
Sarachnis - Obtain 2 cudgels or 1 jar
DT2 - Obtain 3 ring rolls/ingots
Zalcano - Obtain a unique (shard or crystal tool seed) or Smolcano
Fortis Colosseum - Obtain 2 different uniques (excl. shards, pet, quiver)
Vorkath - Obtain any unique (excl. head), jar, or pet
Freestyle - Obtain 1 each of magic, range, and melee weapons from three separate bosses (component pieces such as magic fang count as a full weapon)
Freestyle - Obtain 1 each of head, torso, and leg slot items from three separate bosses (component pieces such as Hueycoatl hide may act as wild cards)
Chambers of Xeric - Obtain a unique (excl. prayer scrolls, pet, kits, dust)
Tempoross - Obtain tome or big harpoonfish
Phantom Muspah - Obtain 2 venator shards
Wilderness - Obtain 3 different odium or malediction shards (no duplicates)
